titleEn: Create and submit a template to Meta (own WhatsApp account)
planGate: package in good standing + active number

undo.note: a submission to Meta cannot be recalled; the template can be edited or deleted afterwards

ar: عايز اعمل رسالة بلغ بيها العميل إن الأوردر اتشحن
en: How do I create a message template?
Write me a template that tells the customer their order shipped

steps: Templates, New template: pick what it is for, language, a title for yourself
Write the text, add variables with an example each, optional header, footer and buttons; Meta's rules are checked while typing and again by the server (check)
Review and send: the preview and the irreversible notice, then confirm; the confirm is bound to the checked payload by a hash
Meta reviews for up to 24 hours
edgeCases: A variable at the start or end of the text, or a gap in numbering, is refused before Meta with the field named
Two taps or two staff tabs submit once (the name is claimed first)
A timeout or 5xx keeps the claim as pending and the sweep reconciles it with Meta
Meta may recategorise UTILITY to MARKETING: the stored category is Meta's and the merchant is told what it changes (opt-in, price, campaigns)
Own number not connected: 404 no_active_number (a store on the shared number sees the platform templates instead, never an empty list)
Connection to WhatsApp expired or closed: 503 token_unavailable, reconnect the number on the Numbers screen
Submitting without expectedHash is refused 400 hash_required
On the shared number: use the request form instead (templates.shared-request)
assistantNote: a submission to Meta on the merchant's account; irreversible (cannot be withdrawn): confirm with the payload preview, pass the hash from check
